title: The Black Friday Bargains Worth Bagging
author: Simon Hill
text:
All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.The Black Friday deals have arrived! Set yourself up with a turkey sandwich and a warm drink, because it's time to shop the best sale event of the year. And after the year we've had, we could all use a few bargains to cheer us up, score that upgrade we've been needing, and get a few gifts in the bag.Featured Prime Day DealUpdated: Nov 27 2026, 07:24 PMEufy Floodlight Cam E340 $220 $150The E340 uses dual-lens camera with a 3K wide-angle lens and a 2K telephoto lens for up to 8x zoom to capture details up to 50 feet away.The Reviews team at WIRED tracks prices on our favorite gadgets year-round, and we highlight deals only on devices we’ve tested and would recommend to our own friends and family. These are the discounts that caught our eye—vetted for price hikes and fake deals. And if you’re looking for something more distinctive and gift-worthy, we’ve curated some special finds on sale.Updated Friday, November 27, at 1:45 PM ET: We’ve added new gaming deals and our favorite deals under $100. We also updated prices and removed deals no longer available.Additional contributors: Louryn Strampe, Scott Gilbertson, Nena Farrell, Kat Merck, Molly Higgins, Boutayna Chokrane, Luke Larsen, Harry Rabinowitz, Les ShuWIRED Featured Deals:Our Go-To Checked Bag: Away The Bigger Carry-On for $221 ($74 off)One Smart Ring to Rule Them All: Oura Ring 5 for $299 ($100 off)Apple’s Best Wireless Earbuds: Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $149 ($100 off)Nothing Beats the Price: Nothing Headphone (a) for $109 ($90 off)The New-Parent Essential: SlumberPod With Fan for $154 ($66 off)Our favorite affordable robot vacuum: Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro for $450 ($350 Off)The Best Android Phone: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL for $899 ($400 off)A Rare Sale on an Excellent Sunrise Alarm: Hatch Sleep Clock for $188 ($62 off)The Perfect Small Laptop: Dell XPS 13 for $550 ($200 Off)A Top OLED TV: LG C6 OLED TV for $1,400 ($1,300 off)A Do-It-All Air Fryer: Typhur Dome 2 for $285 ($105 off)A Few Giftable Things on Sale:Good Time: WIRED’s favorite sub-$400 dive watch is even more irresistible at 20% off.For the Home: Schoolhouse has a great sale going, with quilts, shams, and hooks over 60% off.It’s a Cinch: I endorse this buy-it-for-life, made-in-USA leather belt from Homestead Brand (20% off).Cozy Up: Alex Mill’s wool-and-alpaca crewneck sweater is 39% off and fully stocked.Go Dutch: Great Jones’ The Dutchess, a team favorite, is a whopping 70% off—down to $75!—and produces a mean chili.Upstate Vibes: My favorite shirts for fall are from the mom-and-pop Road to Nowhere in Kingston, New York. This fantastic overshirt is 25% off online.Just My Type: I love the wooden accents on our favorite mechanical keyboard, which is finally under $100.On Our Trail: The iconic Salomon XT-6 trail sneaker is 40% off and stocked in all sizes.For Small Pets: Howie, my 25-pound goldendoodle, says you should save 50% on the Fi Mini.Top Deals: What do you get the guy with too many chore coats? A Harrington jacket—like this excellent one from Todd Snyder, which is 30% off an already half-off ticket. Todd Snyder rarely does sales these days, but this weekend is an exception.Curated by Cooper Fleishman, Executive Commerce Director. Updated Friday, November 27, at 2:30 PM ET.
